This file, `.devin-plugin/plugin.json` and `chock-market.lock` are compiled output, written

No `dry_run: false` run has been dispatched against this repository yet, so there is no
published tree yet for this file to describe truthfully — the table chock's own
`chock marketplace build --tree devin` produces lists each policy's id, version, and whether

CLI/Desktop sessions only — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)) or skill text only.

Once the first Publish run lands, this file carries that real, checkable list. Until then,
see [chock-catalog](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/chock-catalog/blob/main/docs) for the
current policy set, or run the two build commands in the README's "Verify it yourself"
section locally to see the table this repository will carry.
